import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtMapToolkit

/-!
# Functoriality of the étale-sheafified relative Picard functor

The Layer-2 functor `picEt` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEt`) is functorial along an
*arbitrary* morphism `f : T' ⟶ T` of test objects: the value of the restricted family at
an affine open `W ⊆ T'.left` — whose `f`-image need not lie in any affine open of
`T.left` — is *glued* over a finite basic-open refinement of `W` subordinate to the
preimages of affine opens, using the Zariski sheaf property of the affine étale Picard
functor (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffZariskiSep`, `PicEtAffZariskiGlue`) whose
gluing half is licensed by the (C1) étale separatedness.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEt.IsPullbackValue`: the characterizing property of the glued
  value — on every affine sub-open lying in the preimage of an affine open, it restricts
  to the pullback of the family value there.  Values with this property are unique
  (`pullbackValue_unique`, from Zariski separation) and exist
  (`exists_isPullbackValue`, from Zariski gluing).
* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtMap C f : picEt C T →* picEt C T'` with the functor laws
  `picEtMap_id` and `picEtMap_comp`, and the functor
  `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtFunctor C : (Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtAffineEquiv_naturality`: the affine comparison
  (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEt`) is natural in the test algebra.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEt.ext_of_le_cover`: **uniqueness of gluings** — two sections of
  `picEt C T` agreeing on every affine open subordinate to an open cover of `T.left`
  are equal (the separation half of the sheaf property of `picEt` itself).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))

namespace picEt

variable {T T' T'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}

/-! ## The characterizing property of the glued value -/

/-- The characterizing property of the value at `W` of the restriction of `s` along
`f`: on every affine sub-open of `W` contained in the preimage of an affine open `V` of
the target, it restricts to the pullback of the value of `s` at `V`. -/
def IsPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : picEt C T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens)
    (v : PicEtAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (W₀ : T'.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (V : T.left.affineOpens)
    (hV : W₀.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
    PicEtAff.mapAlg C (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) v
      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V)

/-- Values with the pullback property are unique. -/
theorem pullbackValue_unique {f : T' ⟶ T} {s : picEt C T} {W : T'.left.affineOpens}
    {v v' : PicEtAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1)} (hv : IsPullbackValue C f s W v)
    (hv' : IsPullbackValue C f s W v') : v = v' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (fun w _ => by

theorem existsUnique_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : picEt C T)
    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃! v, IsPullbackValue C f s W v := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isPullbackValue C f s W

section Identity

  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable def eCurveId : pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C) ≅ pic0Functor C where
  hom := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
  inv := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom
  hom_inv_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]
  inv_hom_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]

noncomputable def mIdσ :
    Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
  eqToIso (by rw [show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)) = 𝟙 _ by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]]) ≪≫ Over.mapId _

noncomputable def σkkCollapse :
    (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C
      ≅ pic0Functor C :=
  Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op (mIdσ k)).symm (pic0Functor C)
    ≪≫ Functor.leftUnitor (pic0Functor C)

noncomputable def cocycleIdRHS :
    pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C)
      ≅ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C :=
  eCurveId k C ≪≫ (σkkCollapse k C).symm

-- CLAIM UNDER TEST (worksheet :114 / :375): does the K-1a headline even STATE?
#check (pic0Theta k k C = cocycleIdRHS k C : Prop)

-- And: does the file's Leg-1..3 `change` step really typecheck?
example : pic0Theta k k C = cocycleIdRHS k C := by
  apply Iso.ext
  ext T lam
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  change picEtCrossBaseInv k k C (Opposite.unop T) lam.1
    = picEtMap C ((mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T))
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv (Opposite.unop T) lam.1)
  sorry

end Identity

end AlgebraicGeometry

def map {Y : T} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Over X ⥤ Over Y :=

section

variable {Y : T} {f : X ⟶ Y} {U V : Over X} {g : U ⟶ V}

@[simp]
theorem map_obj_left : ((map f).obj U).left = U.left :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem map_obj_hom : ((map f).obj U).hom = U.hom ≫ f :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem map_map_left : ((map f).map g).left = g.left :=
  rfl

/-- If `f` is an isomorphism, `map f` is an equivalence of categories. -/
def mapIso (f : X ≅ Y) : Over X ≌ Over Y :=
  Comma.mapRightIso _ <| Discrete.natIso fun _ ↦ f

@[simp] lemma mapIso_functor (f : X ≅ Y) : (mapIso f).functor = map f.hom := rfl
@[simp] lemma mapIso_inverse (f : X ≅ Y) : (mapIso f).inverse = map f.inv := rfl

instance [IsIso f] : (Over.map f).IsEquivalence := (Over.mapIso <| asIso f).isEquivalence_functor

end

/-! ## K-1a: the θ identity coherence over `Over.pullbackId` -/

section Identity

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]
variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- The iso-grade curve transport at the identity base change: `pic0PullbackNat` of the
frozen `baseChange.idIso`. -/
noncomputable def eCurveId : pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C) ≅ pic0Functor C where
  hom := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
  inv := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom
  hom_inv_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]
  inv_hom_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]

/-- The σ-side collapse at `k → k`: the pushforward `Over.map σ_{kk}` is the identity, via
`σ_{kk} = 𝟙` and `Over.mapId`. -/
noncomputable def mIdσ :
    Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
  let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))
  have hσ : σ = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) := by
    dsimp [σ]
    simp
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun T => Over.isoMk (Iso.refl T.left) (by
    exact (Category.id_comp T.hom).trans
      ((congrArg (fun q => T.hom ≫ q) hσ).trans (Category.comp_id T.hom)).symm)) (fun f => by
      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      simp)

@[simp]
theorem mIdσ_hom_app_left (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    ((mIdσ k).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [mIdσ]

/-- The collapse of the pushed-test functor at `k → k` to the identity. -/
noncomputable def σkkCollapse :
    (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C
      ≅ pic0Functor C :=
  Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op (mIdσ k)).symm (pic0Functor C)
    ≪≫ Functor.leftUnitor (pic0Functor C)

/-- The right-hand side of the θ identity coherence, assembled through the frozen
`baseChange.idIso` vehicle. -/
noncomputable def cocycleIdRHS :
    pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C)
      ≅ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C :=
  eCurveId k C ≪≫ (σkkCollapse k C).symm

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **K-1a — the θ identity coherence** (θ over `Over.pullbackId`): θ at `k → k` is the
trivial comparison, the base-changed curve collapsing to `C` and the pushed test to the
test. -/
theorem pic0Theta_id : pic0Theta k k C = cocycleIdRHS k C := by
  apply Iso.ext
  ext T lam
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  change picEtCrossBaseInv k k C (Opposite.unop T) lam.1
    = picEtMap C ((mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T))
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv (Opposite.unop T) lam.1)
  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
  rw [picEtCrossBaseInv_val, picEtMap_val]
  have hW : W.1 ≤ ((mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T)).left ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    rw [mIdσ_hom_app_left]
    exact le_rfl
  rw [picEtMapVal_eq_mapAlg C _ _ (V := W) hW, picEtPullback_val]
  trace_state
  sorry

end Identity

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# Projection coherence for the degree-zero Picard base-change comparison

For the base-field comparison θ of the degree-zero Picard functor
(`Picard/Pic0ThetaAssembly.lean`), this file proves the two coherences that make θ a
coherent system over the tower of field extensions — the datum-level θ-cocycle
consumed by the frozen `baseChangeIso_id`/`baseChangeIso_comp` at DAT-J:

* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Theta_id` — **the θ identity coherence**: `θ` over `k → k` is
  the trivial comparison, pinned against the frozen `baseChange.idIso` vehicle. The
  base-changed curve collapses to `C` (via `pic0PullbackNat` of `baseChange.idIso`) and
  the pushed test collapses to the test (`σ_{kk} = 𝟙`, `Over.mapId`).
* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Theta_comp` — **the θ cocycle coherence** over a tower
  `k → L → M`: `θ_{k,M} = θ_{k,L} ∘ θ_{L,M}` read across `Over.pullbackComp`, pinned
  against the frozen `baseChange.compIso` vehicle. The RHS transports the source along the
  curve `compIso` (an iso — hence `pic0PullbackNat`), applies `θ_{L,M}`, whiskers `θ_{k,L}`
  through `(Over.map σ_{LM}).op`, and reassociates the two σ-pushes into the single
  `σ_{kM}`-push (the `Over.mapComp` mirror of `compIso`).

Both equalities are stated in bundled `CommGrpCat`-natiso form with the RHSs assembled
through the frozen `baseChange.idIso`/`compIso` vehicles, and proved by reduction to
per-test-object components (`NatTrans.ext` + `CommGrpCat` `hom_ext`) then to the
underlying `picEt` classes (`Subtype.ext`), never a `Grp (Over …)` diagram chase. The
genuinely new content is the section-ring **cocycle over the tower**: the base-field
shuffle for `k → M` is the two-step `k → L` then `L → M`, a `restrictScalars`-tower
identity on `sectionShuffle`. Every seam-crossing step is term-mode (I-0216 notes 1–4).

The θ-cocycle is stated on the curve `C` alone — no `JacobianData` argument — since θ is a
functor comparison; the datum enters only at DAT-J (the W7 datum idiom, D1).

/-! ## Congruence of étale-plus transports (the reduction key)

Both the base-field shuffle (`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle`, via `crossBaseTransportFamily`) and
the curve transport (`PicEtAff.curveMap`, via `curveTransportFamily`) are
`RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom`s, and `picEtAffHom_mk`/`descentHom_coe`/`relPicHom_mk`
express the transport as `CechPic.map` of the family's `hom` scheme morphism. Hence two
families with pointwise-equal `hom` fields induce equal transports — the lemma through which
the two θ-cocycle atoms reduce to a scheme-morphism identity on the product carriers. -/
theorem RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr {kD kE kT : Type u}
    [Field kD] [Field kE] [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    {D : Over (Spec (.of kD))} {E : Over (Spec (.of kE))}
    (S T : RelPicTransportFamily kT D E)
    (h : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
      [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B], S.hom B = T.hom B)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
    [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A] (a : PicEtAff E A) :
    S.picEtAffHom A a = T.picEtAffHom A a := by
    _ = (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := hunit'
    _ = ((crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
          (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
      rw [Category.assoc, crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst]

open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
/-- The inverse same-carrier comparison at the identity field extension is exactly
whiskering by the inverse identity base-change comparison. -/
theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
    (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv =

  apply (Over.isPullback_left ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).hom_ext
  · exact (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst k C B).symm
  · exact (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd k C B).symm

    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

1	/-

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ThetaProjectionCoherence
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Identity coherence for the degree-zero Picard base-change comparison
    10	
    11	This file proves that `pic0Theta` over the identity field extension agrees with the
    12	canonical collapse of the base-changed curve and pushed test object.
    13	-/
    14	
    15	set_option autoImplicit false
    16	
    17	universe u
    18	
    19	open CategoryTheory
    20	
    21	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    22	
    23	section Identity
    24	
    25	variable (k : Type u) [Field k]
    26	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    27	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    28	
    29	/-- The iso-grade curve transport at the identity base change. -/
    30	noncomputable def eCurveId : pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C) ≅ pic0Functor C where
    31	  hom := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
    32	  inv := pic0PullbackNat ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom
    33	  hom_inv_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]
    34	  inv_hom_id := by rw [← pic0PullbackNat_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pic0PullbackNat_id]
    35	
    36	/-- Pushing a test object along the identity field map leaves its carrier unchanged. -/
    37	noncomputable def mIdσ :
    38	    Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
    39	  let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))
    40	  have hσ : σ = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) := by
    41	    dsimp [σ]
    42	    simp
    43	  NatIso.ofComponents (fun T => Over.isoMk (Iso.refl T.left) (by
    44	    exact (Category.id_comp T.hom).trans
    45	      ((congrArg (fun q => T.hom ≫ q) hσ).trans (Category.comp_id T.hom)).symm)) (fun f => by
    46	      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    47	      simp)
    48	
    49	@[simp]
    50	theorem mIdσ_hom_app_left (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    51	    ((mIdσ k).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
    52	  simp [mIdσ]
    53	
    54	/-- The collapse of the pushed-test functor at the identity field extension. -/
    55	noncomputable def σkkCollapse :
    56	    (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C
    57	      ≅ pic0Functor C :=
    58	  Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op (mIdσ k)).symm (pic0Functor C)
    59	    ≪≫ Functor.leftUnitor (pic0Functor C)
    60	
    61	/-- The canonical right-hand side of the theta identity coherence. -/
    62	noncomputable def cocycleIdRHS :
    63	    pic0Functor ((baseChange k k).obj C)
    64	      ≅ (Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).op ⋙ pic0Functor C :=
    65	  eCurveId k C ≪≫ (σkkCollapse k C).symm
    66	
    67	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
    68	/-- The theta comparison over `k -> k` is the canonical identity comparison. -/
    69	theorem pic0Theta_id : pic0Theta k k C = cocycleIdRHS k C := by
    70	  apply Iso.ext
    71	  ext T lam
    72	  refine Subtype.ext ?_
    73	  change picEtCrossBaseInv k k C (Opposite.unop T) lam.1
    74	    = picEtMap C ((mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T))
    75	        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv (Opposite.unop T) lam.1)
    76	  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
    77	  rw [picEtCrossBaseInv_val, picEtMap_val]
    78	  have hW : W.1 ≤ ((mIdσ k).hom.app (Opposite.unop T)).left ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    79	    rw [mIdσ_hom_app_left]
    80	    exact le_rfl
    81	  rw [picEtMapVal_eq_mapAlg C _ _ (V := W) hW, picEtPullback_val]
    82	  sorry
    83	
    84	end Identity
    85	
    86	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ThetaAssembly
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0Pullback
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Projection coherence for the degree-zero Picard base-change comparison
    11	
    12	This file supplies the scheme-level equalities used to compare the affine transport
    13	families underlying `pic0Theta`. It proves that the inverse same-carrier comparison has
    14	the expected first projection over any field extension, and identifies the whole
    15	comparison at the identity extension with whiskering by `baseChange.idIso`.
    16	
    17	The proof keeps the proof-bearing `eqToIso` in `baseChange.idIso` opaque. Its component
    18	projection is obtained from adjunction conjugation and proof irrelevance, avoiding a
    19	large simplifier expansion of `Over.pullbackId`.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-! ## Congruence of étale-plus transports (the reduction key)
    31	
    32	Both the base-field shuffle (`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle`, via `crossBaseTransportFamily`) and
    33	the curve transport (`PicEtAff.curveMap`, via `curveTransportFamily`) are
    34	`RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom`s, and `picEtAffHom_mk`/`descentHom_coe`/`relPicHom_mk`
    35	express the transport as `CechPic.map` of the family's `hom` scheme morphism. Hence two
    36	families with pointwise-equal `hom` fields induce equal transports — the lemma through which
    37	the two θ-cocycle atoms reduce to a scheme-morphism identity on the product carriers. -/
    38	theorem RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr {kD kE kT : Type u}
    39	    [Field kD] [Field kE] [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    40	    {D : Over (Spec (.of kD))} {E : Over (Spec (.of kE))}
    41	    (S T : RelPicTransportFamily kT D E)
    42	    (h : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    43	      [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B], S.hom B = T.hom B)
    44	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]
    45	    [IsScalarTower kD kT A] [IsScalarTower kE kT A] (a : PicEtAff E A) :
    46	    S.picEtAffHom A a = T.picEtAffHom A a := by
    47	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
    48	  | _ U x =>
    49	    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_mk]
    50	    refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk D U) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    51	    rw [RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe, RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom_coe]
    52	    generalize (x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)) = y
    53	    induction y using relPic.ind with
    54	    | mk L =>
    55	      rw [RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom_mk, h]
    56	
    57	/-! ## Base-change-identity/composite pullback helpers -/
    58	
    59	open Limits in
    60	/-- `Over.pullbackId`'s forward comparison has first projection the identity: the
    61	base-change-along-`𝟙` section reads off the original object on the first factor. -/
    62	theorem pullbackId_hom_app_left.{w} {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D]
    63	    {S : D} (X : Over S) :
    64	    (Over.pullbackId.hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom (𝟙 S) := by
    65	  change ((conjugateEquiv (Over.mapPullbackAdj (𝟙 S))
    66	    (Adjunction.id (C := Over S)) (Over.mapId S).inv).app X).left = _
    67	  rw [conjugateEquiv_adjunction_id]
    68	  simp only [Over.comp_left, Over.mapId_inv_app_left,
    69	    Over.mapPullbackAdj_counit_app, Over.homMk_left]
    70	  simp
    71	
    72	open Limits in
    73	private theorem pullbackId_transport_hom_app_left.{w}
    74	    {D : Type w} [Category.{u} D] [HasPullbacks D] {S : D}
    75	    (f : S ⟶ S) (hf : f = 𝟙 S)
    76	    (h : Over.pullback f = Over.pullback (𝟙 S)) (X : Over S) :
    77	    ((eqToIso h ≪≫ Over.pullbackId).hom.app X).left = pullback.fst X.hom f := by
    78	  subst f
    79	  have hh : h = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    80	  cases hh
    81	  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_refl,
    82	    Over.comp_left, Category.id_comp] using pullbackId_hom_app_left X
    83	
    84	open Limits in
    85	/-- The forward identity base-change iso on the frozen `Challenge` spelling has first
    86	projection `pullback.fst` along the trivial base map. -/
    87	theorem baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left (k : Type u) [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    88	    ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left
    89	      = pullback.fst C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
    90	  unfold baseChange.idIso
    91	  exact pullbackId_transport_hom_app_left _ (by simp) _ C
    92	
    93	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
    94	/-- The inverse same-carrier comparison followed by the first projection is the first
    95	projection of the original curve, after composing with the base-change pullback map. -/
    96	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L]
    97	    [Algebra k L] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    98	    [Algebra k A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower k L A] :
    99	    (crossBaseAffineIso k L C A).inv ≫
   100	        ((fst ((baseChange k L).obj C) (overSpec L A)).left ≫
   101	          Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   102	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))) =
   103	      (fst C (overSpec k A)).left := by
   104	  rw [crossBaseAffineIso, Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, Category.assoc,
   105	    Over.crossBaseIso_inv_fst]
   106	  change (C ◁ (mapOverSpecIso k L A).inv).left ≫
   107	    (fst C ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).obj
   108	      (overSpec L A))).left = (fst C (overSpec k A)).left
   109	  exact Over.whiskerLeft_left_fst (mapOverSpecIso k L A).inv
   110	
   111	/-! ## The identity-extension comparison
   112	
   113	The K-1a Leg-4 atom is the scheme identity
   114	`((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv`,
   115	is proved by `(Over.isPullback_left _ _).hom_ext` on the two projections. -/
   116	
   117	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
   118	/-- **The `snd` leg of the K-1a Leg-4 atom**: the whiskered identity base-change comparison
   119	and the affine same-carrier comparison agree on the second projection — both are
   120	`(snd C (overSpec k B)).left`.
   121	
   122	Term-mode by necessity: the identity base change spells its codomain `(𝟭 _).obj C`, so `rw`
   123	reports "did not find an occurrence" on a goal that visibly contains the pattern (the R4/R5
   124	spelling friction of I-0216, measured here). -/
   125	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd (k : Type u) [Field k]
   126	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   127	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
   128	    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
   129	        ≫ (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left
   130	      = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
   131	          ≫ (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
   132	  calc
   133	    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left ≫
   134	        (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
   135	      (snd ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
   136	      Over.whiskerRight_left_snd ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
   137	    _ = (snd C (overSpec k B)).left := rfl
   138	    _ = (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
   139	        (snd ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
   140	      (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_snd k k C B).symm
   141	
   142	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
   143	/-- The inverse cross-base comparison and the whiskered identity base-change comparison
   144	agree on the first projection. -/
   145	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst (k : Type u) [Field k]
   146	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   147	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
   148	    (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
   149	        ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left =
   150	      (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv
   151	        ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
   152	  haveI : IsIso
   153	      (Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   154	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) := by
   155	    rw [← baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left k C]
   156	    exact ((Over.forget _).mapIso ((baseChange.idIso k).app C)).isIso_hom
   157	  apply (cancel_mono
   158	    (Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   159	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))).1
   160	  have hunit :
   161	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   162	          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   163	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   164	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
   165	        (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left := by
   166	    have hcancel : ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left ≫
   167	        ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left = 𝟙 _ :=
   168	      Over.inv_left_hom_left ((baseChange.idIso k).app C)
   169	    calc
   170	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   171	            ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   172	          Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   173	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
   174	        (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   175	          (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left ≫
   176	            ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).hom.left) := by
   177	        rw [← baseChange_idIso_hom_app_left, Category.assoc]
   178	        rfl
   179	      _ = (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
   180	        congrArg (fun q =>
   181	          (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫ q) hcancel
   182	      _ = (fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left :=
   183	        Category.comp_id _
   184	  have hunit' :
   185	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   186	          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   187	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   188	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) =
   189	        (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := by
   190	    simpa only [Functor.id_obj] using hunit
   191	  calc
   192	    ((((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left
   193	          ≫ (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
   194	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   195	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) =
   196	      (((fst ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left ≫
   197	          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv.left) ≫
   198	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   199	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))) :=
   200	      congrArg (fun q => q ≫ Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   201	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))))
   202	        (Over.whiskerRight_left_fst ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
   203	    _ = (fst C (overSpec k B)).left := hunit'
   204	    _ = ((crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv ≫
   205	          (fst ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).left) ≫
   206	        Limits.pullback.fst C.hom
   207	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) := by
   208	      rw [Category.assoc, crossBaseAffineIso_inv_fst]
   209	
   210	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory in
   211	/-- The inverse same-carrier comparison at the identity field extension is exactly
   212	whiskering by the inverse identity base-change comparison. -/
   213	theorem crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight (k : Type u) [Field k]
   214	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   215	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] :
   216	    (crossBaseAffineIso k k C B).inv =
   217	      (((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv ▷ overSpec k B).left := by
   218	  apply (Over.isPullback_left ((baseChange k k).obj C) (overSpec k B)).hom_ext
   219	  · exact (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_fst k C B).symm
   220	  · exact (crossBaseAffineIso_inv_whiskerRight_snd k C B).symm
   221	
   222	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	
    11	For a field embedding `k → L`, a curve bundle `C` over `k` with base change
    12	`C_L = (baseChange k L).obj C`, and an `L`-test object `T`, the B-2 base-field shuffle
    13	`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle` lifts componentwise through the affine-opens limit: étale
    14	Picard classes of `C` on the pushed-forward test `(Over.map σ).obj T`
    15	(`σ = Spec.map (algebraMap k L)`) correspond to étale Picard classes of `C_L` on `T`
    16	itself.  The carriers of `T` and `(Over.map σ).obj T` agree definitionally, so the affine
    17	opens are literally shared; the only genuine seam is the section-ring scalar tower.
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isScalarTower_sections_map`: **the section-ring tower seam** —
    20	  the `k`-algebra structure `Over.sectionsAlgebra ((Over.map σ).obj T) U` and the
    21	  `L`-algebra structure `Over.sectionsAlgebra T U` on `Γ(T.left, U)` form a scalar tower
    22	  (`CommRingCat`-level form: `Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections_map`).
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.sectionShuffle`: the B-2 shuffle at the section ring of an open of
    24	  an `L`-test object, with the `k`-structure through the pushforward; the componentwise
    25	  ingredient of θ, with the restriction squares `mapAlg_sectionShuffle`/`_symm` and the
    26	  pullback square `appLE_sectionShuffle` (the `restrictScalars` reconciliations
    27	  `Over.resAlgHom_map_restrictScalars`/`Over.appLEAlgHom_map_restrictScalars` are
    28	  `rfl`-grade).
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtCrossBase`/`picEtCrossBaseInv`/`picEtCrossBaseEquiv`: **the
    30	  componentwise lift** `picEt C ((Over.map σ).obj T) ≃* picEt C_L T`, transporting a
    31	  compatible family of plus classes affine open by affine open along the shuffle.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtMap_picEtCrossBase` (and `_inv`): **naturality in the test
    33	  object** — the lift commutes with restriction along an arbitrary morphism of `L`-tests
    34	  against its pushforward.  The glued value of `picEtMap` is pinned by the
    35	  `IsPullbackValue` characterization, which the transported family satisfies through the
    36	  `mapAlg`/`appLE` squares of the section-ring shuffle.
    37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtAffineEquiv_picEtCrossBase`: **the affine face** — at an affine
    38	  test `overSpec L A` the lift collapses under the two affine comparisons to the B-2
    39	  shuffle itself, the pushed side being read through the affine matching
    40	  `mapOverSpecIso`.  This is the reduction through which the θ assembly
    41	  (`Picard/Pic0ThetaAssembly.lean`) discharges the `degAt` matching at field points.
    42

    44	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEt`, and `picEtMap` is consumed only through its
    45	`IsPullbackValue` characterization (the w4/F-3 discipline).  Per the I-0206 elaboration
    46	lesson, every seam-crossing step (the `Γ(T.left, U)` vs
    47	`Γ(((Over.map σ).obj T).left, U)` spellings) is done in term mode with type-ascribed

     8	/-!
     9	# The parameterized transport core of the étale plus construction
    10	
    11	The Wave-7 plumbing shared by the curve-direction functoriality (`PicEtAff.curveMap`,
    12	`Picard/PicEtAffCurveMap.lean`) and the base-field shuffle (`PicEtAff.baseFieldShuffle`,
    13	`Picard/PicEtAffBaseFieldShuffle.lean`): transporting étale-plus Picard classes along a
    14	family of scheme morphisms between the product carriers of two curve bundles — possibly
    15	over *different* base fields — indexed by the literally shared étale covers of the affine
    16	test.
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily kT D E`: the input datum.  For curve bundles
    19	  `D` over `kD` and `E` over `kE`, a family of scheme morphisms
    20	  `hom B : (D ⊗ overSpec kD B).left ⟶ (E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left`, compatible with the
    21	  second projections (`hom_snd`) and natural against pairs of algebra maps with equal
    22	  underlying functions (`hom_naturality`).  The family is indexed by all test algebras
    23	  `B` carrying algebra structures over `kD`, `kE` and a common overfield `kT` in scalar
    24	  towers `kD → kT → B` and `kE → kT → B`; `kT` mediates between the two base fields
    25	  without relating them (`kT = kD = kE` for the curve-morphism family; `kT = L` for the
    26	  base-field shuffle, where `{kD, kE} = {k, L}`).
    27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily.relPicHom`: the induced transport of relative
    28	  Picard groups, with `relPicHom_mk` and the bilateral naturality square
    29	  `relPicAlgMap_relPicHom` against restriction along same-function algebra-map pairs.
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily.descentHom`: descent classes map to descent
    31	  classes over the shared cover index, commuting with refinement transport
    32	  (`descentHom_descentMap`).
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom`: the induced homomorphism
    34	  `PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A` of étale-plus groups, with the `mk`-computation rule
    35	  (`picEtAffHom_mk`), naturality of the unit (`picEtAffHom_unit`), the bilateral
    36	  restriction squares (`map_picEtAffHom`, `mapAlg_picEtAffHom`), and the two-sided
    37	  collapse `picEtAffHom_picEtAffHom` (families with pointwise-inverse scheme morphisms
    38	  induce mutually inverse transports — the `≃*` engine of the base-field shuffle).
    39	
    40	Everything is stated through the landed `relPicMk`/`relPic.ind`/`relPicAlgMap` and
    41	`PicEtAff.mk`/`ind`/`mk_eq_mk_iff`/`descentMap` interfaces; nothing unfolds the plus
    42	setoid or the relative Picard quotient beyond them.
    43	-/

    57	/-- A transport family between the relative Picard theories of a curve bundle `D` over
    58	`kD` and a curve bundle `E` over `kE`, on affine tests: for every test algebra `B` in
    59	scalar towers over both base fields through a common overfield `kT`, a scheme morphism
    60	between the product carriers, compatible with the second projections and natural in `B`.
    61	Descending along `Scheme.CechPic.map`, such a family induces a transport
    62	`PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A` of étale-plus Picard groups over the literally shared
    63	étale-cover index (`picEtAffHom`). -/
    64	structure RelPicTransportFamily (kT : Type u) [Field kT] [Algebra kD kT] [Algebra kE kT]
    65	    (D : Over (Spec (.of kD))) (E : Over (Spec (.of kE))) where
    66	  /-- The underlying family of scheme morphisms between the product carriers. -/
    67	  hom : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    68	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B],
    69	    (D ⊗ overSpec kD B).left ⟶ (E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left
    70	  /-- The family commutes with the second projections (both carriers project to the
    71	  shared scheme `Spec B`). -/
    72	  hom_snd : ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    73	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B],
    74	    hom B ≫ (snd E (overSpec kE B)).left = (snd D (overSpec kD B)).left
    75	  /-- The family is natural against restriction along any pair of algebra maps over the
    76	  two base fields with equal underlying functions. -/
    77	  hom_naturality : ∀ (B B' : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B]
    78	    [Algebra kT B] [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
    79	    [CommRing B'] [Algebra kD B'] [Algebra kE B'] [Algebra kT B']
    80	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B'] [IsScalarTower kE kT B']
    81	    (fD : B →ₐ[kD] B') (fE : B →ₐ[kE] B'), (∀ b, fD b = fE b) →
    82	    hom B' ≫ (E ◁ Over.overSpecMap fE).left
    83	      = (D ◁ Over.overSpecMap fD).left ≫ hom B

    95	section RelPicHom
    96	
    97	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
    98	  [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
    99	
   100	/-- Pullback of Čech classes along the family sends classes pulled back from the shared
   101	test `Spec B` to classes pulled back from `Spec B`: well-definedness of the transport on
   102	the cosets. -/
   103	lemma picFromBase_le_comap_hom :
   104	    picFromBase E (overSpec kE B)
   105	      ≤ (picFromBase D (overSpec kD B)).comap (CechPic.map (T.hom B)) := by
   106	  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
   107	  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
   108	  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, T.hom_snd]
   109	  rfl
   110	
   111	/-- The relative Picard transport induced by the family at a test algebra: pull back
   112	Čech classes along `hom B` and descend to the quotients. -/
   113	def relPicHom : relPic E (overSpec kE B) →* relPic D (overSpec kD B) :=
   114	  QuotientGroup.map (picFromBase E (overSpec kE B)) (picFromBase D (overSpec kD B))
   115	    (CechPic.map (T.hom B)) (T.picFromBase_le_comap_hom B)
   116	
   117	@[simp]
   118	lemma relPicHom_mk (L : (E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left.CechPic) :
   119	    T.relPicHom B (relPicMk E (overSpec kE B) L)
   120	      = relPicMk D (overSpec kD B) (CechPic.map (T.hom B) L) :=
   121	  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ L
   122	
   123	end RelPicHom

   132	/-- **The bilateral naturality square**: the family transport commutes with restriction
   133	along any pair of algebra maps over the two base fields with equal underlying
   134	functions.  Every compatibility of the plus-level transport reduces to this square. -/
   135	theorem relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (fD : B →ₐ[kD] B') (fE : B →ₐ[kE] B')
   136	    (hf : ∀ b, fD b = fE b) (x : relPic E (overSpec kE B)) :
   137	    relPicAlgMap D fD (T.relPicHom B x) = T.relPicHom B' (relPicAlgMap E fE x) := by
   138	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   139	  | mk L =>
   140	    rw [relPicHom_mk, relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk, relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk,
   141	      relPicHom_mk]
   142	    refine congrArg (relPicMk D (overSpec kD B')) ?_
   143	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   144	      ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, T.hom_naturality B B' fD fE hf]
   145	
   146	end RelPicSquare

   148	/-- Families with pointwise-inverse scheme morphisms induce mutually inverse relative
   149	Picard transports: the round trip along `T` then `S` is the identity when
   150	`S.hom B ≫ T.hom B = 𝟙`. -/
   151	theorem relPicHom_relPicHom (S : RelPicTransportFamily kT E D)
   152	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra kD B] [Algebra kE B] [Algebra kT B]
   153	    [IsScalarTower kD kT B] [IsScalarTower kE kT B]
   154	    (h : S.hom B ≫ T.hom B = 𝟙 ((E ⊗ overSpec kE B).left))
   155	    (x : relPic E (overSpec kE B)) :
   156	    S.relPicHom B (T.relPicHom B x) = x := by
   157	  induction x using relPic.ind with
   158	  | mk L =>
   159	    rw [relPicHom_mk, relPicHom_mk]
   160	    refine congrArg (relPicMk E (overSpec kE B)) ?_
   161	    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, h, Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
   162	    rfl

   168	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra kD A] [Algebra kE A] [Algebra kT A]

   171	/-- The descent condition is preserved by the family transport: the two double-cover
   172	pullbacks of the transported class agree, by the bilateral square at the two coprojections
   173	(which are algebra maps over both base fields with the same underlying function). -/
   174	theorem relPicHom_mem_descentClasses {U : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   175	    {x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)} (hx : x ∈ descentClasses E U) :
   176	    T.relPicHom U.Carrier x ∈ descentClasses D U := by
   177	  rw [mem_descentClasses_iff] at hx ⊢
   178	  rw [T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (doubleInl U) (doubleInl U) (fun _ => rfl) x,
   179	    T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (doubleInr U) (doubleInr U) (fun _ => rfl) x, hx]
   180	
   181	/-- The descent-class transport induced by the family, over the literally shared étale
   182	cover index. -/
   183	def descentHom (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
   184	    descentClasses E U →* descentClasses D U :=
   185	  ((T.relPicHom U.Carrier).comp (descentClasses E U).subtype).codRestrict _
   186	    fun x => T.relPicHom_mem_descentClasses x.2
   187	
   188	@[simp]
   189	lemma descentHom_coe (U : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses E U) :
   190	    (T.descentHom U x : relPic D (overSpec kD U.Carrier))
   191	      = T.relPicHom U.Carrier (x : relPic E (overSpec kE U.Carrier)) :=
   192	  rfl

   195	plus-level transport well defined on `mk`-equal representatives. -/

   197	    (x : descentClasses E U) :
   198	    T.descentHom V (descentMap E h x) = descentMap D h (T.descentHom U x) := by
   199	  ext
   200	  rw [descentHom_coe, descentMap_coe, descentMap_coe, descentHom_coe,
   201	    T.relPicAlgMap_relPicHom (h.restrictScalars kD) (h.restrictScalars kE)
   202	      (fun _ => rfl)]

   211	/- Stated with the sigma pairs destructured, so that no goal mentions a sigma-literal
   212	projection. -/
   213	private lemma mapSig_rel {U V : Algebra.EtaleCover A} {x : descentClasses E U}
   214	    {y : descentClasses E V} (F : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (f : U.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)

    49	/-- Two `k`-algebra structures on the same ring sitting in a scalar tower over the
    50	identity algebra `Algebra.id k` are equal — the seam that collapses the transport core's
    51	two-sided instance index at the diagonal `kD = kE = kT = k`. -/
    52	private lemma algebra_eq_of_tower {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (iT iD : Algebra k B)
    53	    (tw : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul) :
    54	    iD = iT := by
    55	  refine Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => ?_
    56	  rw [@IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k B _ _ _ (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw]
    57	  rfl

    59	/-- The whisker transport family of a curve morphism `g : D ⟶ E`: at every test algebra
    60	`B`, pullback of Čech classes along `(g ▷ overSpec k B).left`.  The `hom` field is
    61	stated across the two instance slots of the transport core's index; the scalar towers
    62	collapse them (`algebra_eq_of_tower`), and at a shared instance the field is
    63	definitionally the whisker itself (`curveTransportFamily_hom`). -/
    64	noncomputable def curveTransportFamily (g : D ⟶ E) : RelPicTransportFamily k D E where
    65	  hom B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
    66	    obtain rfl : iE = iD :=
    67	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE).trans (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD).symm
    68	    obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
    69	    exact (g ▷ overSpec k B).left
    70	  hom_snd B _ iD iE iT twD twE := by
    71	    obtain rfl : iE = iD :=
    72	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE).trans (algebra_eq_of_tower iT iD twD).symm
    73	    obtain rfl : iE = iT := algebra_eq_of_tower iT iE twE
    74	    change (g ▷ overSpec k B).left ≫ (snd E (overSpec k B)).left
    75	      = (snd D (overSpec k B)).left
    76	    rw [← Over.comp_left, whiskerRight_snd]
    77	  hom_naturality B B' _ iDB iEB iTB twDB twEB _ iDB' iEB' iTB' twDB' twEB' fD fE hf := by
    78	    obtain rfl : iEB = iDB :=
    79	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iEB twEB).trans (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iDB twDB).symm
    80	    obtain rfl : iEB = iTB := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB iEB twEB
    81	    obtain rfl : iEB' = iDB' :=
    82	      (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iEB' twEB').trans
    83	        (algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iDB' twDB').symm
    84	    obtain rfl : iEB' = iTB' := algebra_eq_of_tower iTB' iEB' twEB'
    85	    obtain rfl : fD = fE := AlgHom.ext hf
    86	    change (g ▷ overSpec k B').left ≫ (E ◁ Over.overSpecMap fD).left
    87	      = (D ◁ Over.overSpecMap fD).left ≫ (g ▷ overSpec k B).left
    88	    rw [← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left, whisker_exchange]

   108	/-- **Functoriality of the étale plus construction in the curve**: a morphism of curve
   109	bundles `g : D ⟶ E` over `Spec k` induces a homomorphism of étale-plus Picard groups
   110	`PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A` at every affine test, over the literally shared étale
   111	cover index — descent-class representatives transport by `relPicMapCurveApp` on the same
   112	cover. -/
   113	def curveMap (g : D ⟶ E) : PicEtAff E A →* PicEtAff D A :=
   114	  (curveTransportFamily g).picEtAffHom A

   121	    curveMap A g (mk E U x) = mk D U ((curveTransportFamily g).descentHom U x) :=

   131	          (x : relPic E (overSpec k U.Carrier)) :=
